rationale: Price is at the absolute session high (100% of range) after a sharp 3-candle ramp of ~$1.55 in the opening minutes on 3.12x relative volume, making a long entry extremely late with no pullback or consolidation to define a clean stop. A short against the high is tempting but the momentum is strongly upward with no reversal signal yet, and the spread/liquidity on a large-cap ADR in the first few minutes of regular session adds execution risk. With two working orders already consuming 7% of buying power, the risk/reward here does not justify adding a third position.
